approved: Regional Australia, Local Government, Arts and Sport

Supported the Australian Capital Territory (Self-Government) Amendment Bill 2013 on Canberra's centenary, recounted that residents voted 63½ per cent against self-government in a 1978 plebiscite before the Hawke government granted it in 1988, and noted the first elected Legislative Assembly began with 18 members in 1974 compared with 17 today.

Marked Canberra's centenary, noted the Australian government has contributed $20 million to National Arboretum visitor facilities, argued using a cube root population rule the ACT assembly of 17 members is undersized compared with a suggested minimum of 25 MLAs, and paid tribute to the late ACT and Region Chamber of Commerce chief executive Chris Peters, who died on 27 February this year.
